card.name: Percentages before 'of' in prevalence statistics
card.fires_on: The word 'of' or 'are' right after a percentage or proportion (e.g. 16%, 15 percent, 1 in 2) in statements about how common a condition is in a population.

modes.label: After a percentage
modes.description: 'of' or 'are' directly after a percent figure describing a share of a group.
